_comment: English bodies for haystack (framework). Mechanism per C0-1..6. No extraSections in source; sections/sectionTitles omitted. layer_position/providers not rendered — not included.

axes.model_access: Generation and embedding models plug in via integrations (OpenAI/Anthropic/local HF and the like, per the official integration catalog, not itemized one by one); the RAG retrieval stack (dense/sparse/hybrid) is its home turf.
axes.runtime: A Python library (pip-installed into your process); GitHub 26,880★, last push 2026-10-30 (API verified). The pipeline abstraction is the main axis: components wired into a graph, batch or serving — it all runs inside your process.
axes.local_files: Document indexes and retrieval data live in the storage you choose (files/vector stores/document stores) — data never leaves your side; the deepset Cloud hosted line is a separate product surface.
axes.background: A library has no resident semantics; indexing pipelines can run offline in batches, and the query service is deployed by you. 2.x rewrote 1.x's node system into the component/pipeline model — upgrading is a major rewrite, not a smooth migration.
axes.tools: The agent layer (since 2.x) includes a tool-calling loop; MCP support status not itemized.
axes.context: A conversation-memory component exists (the chat message store line); cross-session memory requires wiring your own storage — the component gives the pattern, not hosting.
axes.permissions: No account system (library form); the permissions surface = the various vendors' keys and storage credentials you wire in. The deepset Cloud upload surface follows a different line's terms.
axes.fit: Fits: production-grade RAG pipelines (retrieval-quality engineering: hybrid/reranker/evaluation loops), component graphs you can audit. Does not fit: just wanting a thin chat shell (too heavy); deep agent orchestration (the LangGraph line is more specialized).

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The test protocol is at [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md).
unknowns:
- The full integration catalog (not itemized one by one)
- Current completeness of the agent layer and MCP support (not itemized)
- Details of deepset Cloud's data-processing terms (a separate product surface, not itemized)
related: The RAG two-headed contrast: LlamaIndex starts from the data-ingestion side, Haystack from the pipeline-engineering side.
Component-ecosystem contrast: LangChain has a wider integration surface, Haystack a more specialized retrieval pipeline.
